meta.description: Release Intel 'analytics' mission executor. Acks the dispatch immediately, then collects Spotify/Apple/YouTube/TikTok/Instagram metrics once those credentials are connected, and posts results to POST /api/release-intel/missions/:missionId/callback — DATIAM compares against the prior snapshot on receipt. Requires n8n env vars DATIAM_API_URL and DATIAM_WEBHOOK_SECRET.
